engine.psdsmart.linkMissing: A linked smart object's file is missing: {list} — showing the last look saved in the file (the link is kept on save)
engine.psdsmart.linkUnknown: Couldn't look for a linked smart object's file (the document's folder is unknown): {list} — showing the last look saved in the file (the link is kept on save)
engine.psdsmart.linkFound: Found the files of {n} linked smart objects next to the document: {list} — the screen shows the look saved in the file; edit a linked file by opening it
engine.psdsmart.tooBig: The smart object is too large
engine.psdsmart.entryFixed: This smart object entry's data cannot be replaced
engine.psdsmart.jpegAsPng: The JPEG smart object's contents were put back as PNG so they are not compressed again
engine.psdsmart.notSmart: This is not a smart object layer
engine.psdsmart.noRedraw: A smart object with a warp, smart filters or a mask cannot have edited contents drawn back into it
psdsmart.linked: This is a linked smart object — open and edit the linked file itself: {path}
psdsmart.linkedMissing: The linked smart object's file is missing: {path} — showing the last look saved in the file
psdsmart.cannotOpen: The contents of '{name}' are in a format that cannot be opened here (PSB, PSD, PNG and JPEG only)
psdsmart.noData: The contents of '{name}' were not found in the original PSD
psdsmart.opened: Opened the contents of smart object '{name}' in a new tab — saving (Ctrl+S) puts them back into the original document
psdsmart.parentGone: The original document is closed, so the contents cannot go back into the smart object — saving separately
psdsmart.putting: Putting the contents back into the smart object
psdsmart.putBack: Put the new contents into smart object '{name}' — they are saved when the original document is saved as PSD
psdsmart.failed: Couldn't put the contents back into the smart object: {error}
psdsmart.badgeEmbedded: Smart object (embedded: {name}) — double-click to edit its contents
psdsmart.badgeFixed: Smart object (embedded: {name}) — it has a warp, smart filters or a mask, so edited contents cannot be put back
psdsmart.badgeClosed: Smart object ({name}) — contents of this format cannot be opened here
psdsmart.badgeFound: Linked smart object: {path} (found next to the document)
engine.psd16.open: 16-bit document: display and editing work at 8-bit precision (256 levels per channel). Pixels you leave unchanged keep their original 16-bit values when saved, but changed pixels take 8-bit levels — only the original pixel's detail below one 8-bit level is carried over; this is not editing at 16-bit precision (newly painted areas are plain 8-bit levels)
engine.psd16.saved: {n} layers with changed pixels in a 16-bit document: unchanged pixels were saved with their original 16-bit values, changed pixels at 8-bit precision (the edited 8-bit level with only the original pixel's detail below it carried over — the changed areas have 8-bit tonal steps)
engine.psdsmart.resaved: {n} smart objects with edited contents: the new contents were embedded again and the layer pixels redrawn through their transform (kept as smart objects)
engine.psdsmart.fixedOpen: {n} smart objects with a warp, smart filters or a mask: their contents can be opened, but edited contents cannot be drawn back into the layer (the saved pixels and the original are kept)
engine.psdsmart.editableOpen: {n} smart objects: double-click one in the Layers panel or use 'Edit Smart Object Contents' to open and edit its contents separately (saving puts them back into the original document)
psdsmart.instances: Redrew all {n} layers that use the same contents
psdsmart.instancesKept: {n} layers that use the same contents have a warp, smart filters or a mask, so they could not be redrawn and keep their previous look (saving as PSD still replaces the contents)
